name: Alagón del Río (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white triangle issuing from the hoist bearing the crowned municipal arms of Alagón del Río (a tree above waves on red).
history: The arms and the flag of Alagón were approved by the Order of 29 June 2000 for the entidad local menor of Alagón, published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 11 July 2000, approved by the Consejera de Presidencia María Antonia Trujillo.
